text:
Marcus SRE: paging — seeing spike in 5xx + timeouts for Dedicated/Private routes in us-west1 starting ~21:07 UTC. Multiple customers reporting request failures; console shows 502/504 surge. P95 latency also up. Notified oncall. Will open vendor escalation.
IncidentBot: Incident created INC-2026-081 — severity: elevated. Paging oncall.
Marcus SRE: opened GCP escalation, case ID GCP-INC-987654. GCP initial triage: possible inter-region BGP flaps between us-west1 edge and backbone. Filing traceroutes and sample logs below. @Asha (oncall) can you take if I need handoff?
Asha (oncall): taking — I'm available. Marcus, paste traceroute & netstat when you have them. I'll start drafting status page text.
Marcus SRE: here are quick artifacts:
```
traceroute to api.private.redwood.com (10.128.34.12), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1 10.128.0.1 0.7 ms 0.6 ms 0.6 ms
 2 100.64.0.1 1.2 ms 1.1 ms 1.1 ms
 3 35.191.12.77 15.8 ms 15.6 ms 15.5 ms
 4 34.120.14.9 * * *
 5 34.120.14.9 120.3 ms 121.0 ms 119.8 ms
```
and some sample logs showing repeated connection resets + TLS handshakes failing to complete.
Marcus SRE: routing flaps line up with visible increases in control-plane errors (kv-cache misses etc).
Lina PM: thanks. Draft status page: "Customers in us-west1 may experience increased errors and elevated latency for Dedicated and Private deployments. We are working with our cloud provider (GCP) on an active network mitigation and will post updates. No data loss reported." Keep it short. We'll also prepare a targeted email to impacted customers.
IncidentBot: suggested severity: S2 (service degraded) — recommend targeted customer notification within 30 minutes.
Marcus SRE: GCP Support just replied on the escalation: "We are seeing transient interface errors on a subset of edge routers in us-west1. Engineering running an emergency fix to withdraw problematic routes and re-advertise healthy ones. Ticket GCP-INC-987654. Rolling mitigation now; ETA 10-15m."
GCP Support: @Redwood team — mitigation applied to two edge routers. We're observing route reconvergence; please confirm if you see improvements on your side. We'll keep the ticket open for 2h monitoring.
Asha (oncall): thanks. I'm going to publish a brief status page update now and queue the email to impacted accounts. Draft status page update below for quick paste: 
"We are investigating increased request failures and latency for workloads in us-west1. Our cloud provider is performing network mitigations; some customers may see intermittent failures. We will update here within 15 minutes."
Asha (oncall): customer email draft (subject + body) below — comments welcome:
Subject: Service disruption affecting us-west1 Dedicated/Private — current status
Body: Hello — We're currently investigating elevated error rates and latency for Dedicated and Private deployments hosted in us-west1. Our engineering team is working with our cloud provider (GCP) on a mitigation. No customer data loss has been identified. We will follow up with updates within 30 minutes and provide a post-incident report once the issue is resolved. If you are experiencing severe production impact please reply to this message or open a support case and reference GCP-INC-987654.
Marcus SRE: quick telemetry check — 5xx rate peaked at 18% for some routes, now down to ~3% after mitigation started. P95 latency trending down. I'm keeping an eye on KV cache warmups.
Lina PM: decision: publish status page now, send targeted email to impacted accounts, set internal severity to S2, and start collecting prompts/evals for regression analysis later. I'll own the customer comms with Marcus as technical lead; postmortem owners: Lina + Marcus.
IncidentBot: scheduled on-call handoff: Asha (oncall) at 21:30 UTC — Marcus handing off now.
Marcus SRE: handing off to Asha. Notes: GCP case GCP-INC-987654; mitigation applied at ~21:18 UTC; observed error drop. Saved graphs: https://internal-graphs.redwood/incident/1955501234
GCP Support: update — interfaces stabilized after withdraw/advertise; monitoring for 20m. If you see any reoccurrence open the case and we'll escalate to network infra.
Asha (oncall): confirming I see the same improvements. Will keep monitoring for the 30m stability window before closing. Publishing status page now and sending the email to impacted accounts.
Lina PM: also prepare partner/vendor comms log: GCP contacts used, case number, primary eng contact, and timestamped actions. We'll attach this to the incident timeline for audit.
Marcus SRE: note for postmortem: consider adding automated failover rule to re-route Dedicated traffic to us-west2 when inter-region BGP instability is detected.
GCP Support: we have recorded the incident and will provide a root cause update in the next 48h with packet captures and interface counters attached.
Asha (oncall): thanks all — I'm taking command. Will post a final update once we've had 30m of stability, or earlier if it regresses.
IncidentBot: last update stored. Incident status: monitoring.
